about/hero_title: TodayTourist – With you on every journey
about/slogan: TODAYTOURIST – WITH YOU ACROSS FIVE CONTINENTS
about/p1: TodayTourist warmly welcomes you! First of all, the staff of TodayTourist Travel Company would like to wish all our customers and their families good health, peace and prosperity.
about/p2: TodayTourist is a professional travel operator in Dong Nai with more than 10 years of experience organizing domestic and international tours, teambuilding – gala – events and tailor-made itineraries for individuals, families, companies and groups.
about/p3: With a young, dynamic and experienced team, TodayTourist confidently meets a wide range of needs — even the most demanding customers — delivering trips that are complete, reassuring and memorable.
about/p4: Aiming to become a leading trusted travel brand in Southern Vietnam, TodayTourist constantly improves service quality, refines products and optimizes the customer experience on every journey.
about/mission: “Our customers' smile is the foundation of our sustainable growth.”
about/thanks: Thank you for trusting and choosing TodayTourist.

tours/list_text: Discover attractive domestic and international journeys, carefully designed for every kind of traveler.
tours/tour_1_name: Sa Dec Flower Village Tour – 1 Day
tours/tour_1_desc: Discover Sa Dec, the largest ornamental flower village in the Mekong Delta, blooming with hundreds of flower species all year round.
tours/tour_1_highlights: Visit Sa Dec flower village|Photos with blooming gardens|Experienced tour guide|Round-trip transfers
tours/tour_2_desc: Con Dao – the jewel island in the East Sea with pristine beaches and a rich marine ecosystem.
tours/tour_2_highlights: Swim at An Hai & Dam Trau beaches|Snorkeling over coral reefs|Visit Con Dao prison|Standard hotel
tours/tour_3_name: Chau Doc – Tra Su Melaleuca Forest Tour 1N1D
tours/tour_3_desc: A journey to the border town of Chau Doc, rowing through the flooded Tra Su cajeput forest.
tours/tour_3_highlights: Boat trip through Tra Su forest|Lady Xu (Ba Chua Xu) Temple|Round-trip transfers|Tour guide on board
tours/tour_4_desc: Mui Ne – a coastal paradise with golden sand dunes, Fairy Stream and some of Vietnam's finest resorts.
tours/tour_4_highlights: Flying sand dunes of Mui Ne|Fairy Stream – Ong Hoang Villa|Fresh seafood|Beachfront hotel
tours/tour_5_desc: Nha Trang – a beautiful coastal city with a stunning bay, green islands and delicious seafood.
tours/tour_5_highlights: Explore Nha Trang bay|Hon Mun & Hon Tam islands|Po Nagar Cham Towers|3-star hotel
tours/tour_6_name: Tien Giang – Ben Tre – Can Tho Tour 2N1D
tours/tour_6_desc: The Mekong Delta with lush orchards, the Cai Rang floating market and cool green canals.
tours/tour_6_highlights: Cai Rang floating market|Orchard gardens|Boat trip on the Tien river|Mekong specialties
tours/tour_7_desc: Vung Tau – a coastal city close to Saigon with Back Beach, the Jesus statue and fresh seafood.
tours/tour_7_highlights: Swim at Back Beach|Christ the King statue|Vung Tau Lighthouse|Fresh seafood
tours/tour_8_desc: The Land of Smiles — bustling Bangkok, the blue seas of Pattaya and dazzling golden temples.
tours/tour_8_highlights: Grand Palace Bangkok|Pattaya beaches|Damnoen Saduak floating market|Round-trip flights
tours/tour_9_desc: The land of kimchi — modern Seoul, Gyeongbokgung Palace and the romantic Nami Island.
tours/tour_9_highlights: Gyeongbokgung Palace|Nami Island|N Seoul Tower|Round-trip flights
tours/tour_10_desc: The land of the rising sun — modern Tokyo, majestic Mount Fuji and lively Osaka.
tours/tour_10_highlights: Mount Fuji|Tokyo city tour|Osaka Dotonbori|Round-trip flights
tours/tour_11_desc: The vast Middle Kingdom — glittering Shanghai, classical Suzhou gardens and grand Chinese cuisine.
tours/tour_11_highlights: Shanghai Lujiazui|Suzhou classical gardens|Chinese cuisine|Round-trip flights
